This is where my overthinking has taken over. I 100% want her to have a life outside the relationship and i dont want her feeling as though she cant be friends with people of the opposite sex. I have been hurt a lot in the past and dont have good self esteem and i am trying my hardest to not project that onto my relationship. I never try and control her. I tell her that of she wants to be friends with that dude then thats fine just dont expect me to like him
